topics.title: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) & Query Execution Plans
topics.objective: Diagnose query bottlenecks by identifying sequential scans, nested loops, and disk memory spillages.
topics.example: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, VERBOSE) SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = 42;
topics.exercise: Profile an unindexed join query and identify the exact cost and buffer cache hit ratio.

topics.title: B-Tree, GIN, GiST & Partial Covering Indexes
topics.objective: Select appropriate index strategies for text search, JSONB queries, and high-frequency filtered subsets.
topics.example: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_pending ON orders (user_id) WHERE status = 'PENDING';
topics.exercise: Construct a GIN index on a JSONB metadata column and benchmark search execution speedup.

topics.title: Declarative Table Partitioning (Range & Hash)
topics.objective: Partition billion-row tables by date ranges to enable partition pruning and instant archival drops.
topics.example: CREATE TABLE logs (created_at timestamptz) PARTITION BY RANGE (created_at);
topics.exercise: Partition an event telemetry table into monthly sub-tables and verify partition pruning in EXPLAIN plans.

topics.title: MVCC, Autovacuum Tuning & Table Bloat Mitigation
topics.objective: Configure autovacuum cost limits and freeze thresholds to prevent write amplification and dead tuple bloat.
topics.exercise: Inspect table dead tuple bloat using pg_stat_user_tables and configure per-table autovacuum thresholds.

topics.title: Connection Pooling with PgBouncer & High Availability
topics.objective: Scale backend concurrency without exhausting PostgreSQL backend worker process memory.
topics.exercise: Configure PgBouncer in transaction pooling mode and benchmark throughput under 2,000 concurrent clients.
